agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 22, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Proclamation to Bob McSeveney
4B.
Presentation of Senior Citizen of the Year Award and Service to Seniors Award
4C.
Presentation of Mayor’s Certificates of Recognition to the La Costa Canyon Dance Program State Champions
4D.
Presentation of Proclamation to Nancy Hardwick, representing Mom’s Demand Action, declaring June 7, 2019 as National Gun Violence Awareness Day
4E.
Presentation by Lobbyist Jonathan Clay regarding pending bills and legislation affecting Encinitas
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the May 8, 2019 Special Meeting-Closed Session and May 8, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-05-22 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-05-22 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
County of San Diego Contract Number 547764 Agreement, amendment number 12 with the City of Encinitas for the Senior Nutrition Program. Contact Person: Senior Center Manager Goodsell
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute amendment number 12 of contract number 547764, with the County of San Diego, in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 (of the agenda report) in conjunction with the City Attorney extending the term from June 30, 2019, to December 31, 2019, amending the payment schedule and increasing estimated revenue to the City by $33,995 for a total not to exceed 356,596.
2019-05-22 Item 08C County of San Diego Contract Number 547764 Agreement Amendment Number 12 for the Senior Nutrition Program
8D.
Recreation Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services – Intrepid Shakespeare Company. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor Rundle
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute a one-year contract with up to three (3) one-year renewal options between the City of Encinitas and the Intrepid Shakespeare Company, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 (of the agenda report), commencing upon the date of its execution by both parties to provide acting classes and camps through the Parks, Recreation, and Cultural Arts Department.
2019-05-22 Item 08D Recreation Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services – Intrepid Shakespeare Company revised
8E.
Recreation Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services – Brent Stephens, DBA Concept Creative LLC. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor Rundle
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute a one-year contract with up to three (3) one-year renewal options between the City of Encinitas and Brent Stephens, DBA Concept Creative LLC, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 (of the agenda report), commencing upon the date of its execution by both parties to provide surf camps and instructional surf programs through the Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Department.
2019-05-22 Item 08E Recreation Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services – Brent Stephens, DBA Concept Creative LLC.
8F.
Recreation Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services – Crystal Hollins, DBA CLHK Incorporated. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor Rundle
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute a one-year contract with up to three (3) one-year renewal options between the City of Encinitas and Crystal Hollins, DBA CLHK Incorporated, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 (of the agenda report), commencing upon the date of its execution by both parties to provide Beach Kids camps through the Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Department.
2019-05-22 Item 08F Recreation Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services – Crystal Hollins, DBA CLHK Incorporated.
8G.
Recreation Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services – Master Sports. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor II Lainfiesta
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute a one-year contract with up to three (3) one-year renewal options between the City of Encinitas and Master Sports, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 (of the agenda report), commencing upon the date of its execution by both parties to provide sports leagues, camps, and classes through the Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Department.
2019-05-22 Item 08G Recreation Instructor Agreement for Independent Contract Services – Master Sports
8H.
Public Hearing to Receive Testimony Regarding the FY 2019-20 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Management Analyst Ruess
1) Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the FY 2019-20 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District (ELLD) Annual Engineer’s Report; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-16 entitled, “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Renewing the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District (Zones A, B, C, D, E, F, G & H), confirming the FY 2019-20 Engineer’s Report and ordering the transmission of charges to the County Auditor for collection”.
2019-05-22 Item 08H ELLD Public Hearing - FY19-20
8I.
Memorandum of Understanding Between the City of Encinitas and iPalpiti Artists International. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
Approve a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Encinitas and iPalpiti Artists International to provide a music festival for the community from July 11-14, 2019.
2019-05-22 Item 08I MOU with iPalpiti Artists International
8J.
Fourth Amendment to the Agreement for Cooperative Management Services by and between the City of Del Mar, City of Encinitas, and City of Solana Beach. Contact Person: Fire Chief Stein
1) Approve the Fourth Amendment to the Agreement for Cooperative Management Services by and between the City of Del Mar, City of Encinitas, and the City of Solana Beach in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 in consultation with the City Attorney; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement to be effective on July 1, 2019 on behalf of the City of Encinitas.
2019-05-22 Item 08J Fourth Amendment to Cooperative Management Services
8K.
Legislative Position Letter in Opposition to SB 330 (Skinner). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Approve the position letter of opposition to SB 330 for the Mayor's signature.
2019-05-22 Item 08K Legislative Letter of Opposition SB330
8L.
Amendment to Agreement with San Elijo Lagoon Conservancy for the Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline Project. Contact Person: Program Administrator Timberlake
1) Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment 1 to the Agreement with San Elijo Lagoon Conservancy in the amount of $116,600 for a new total not-to-exceed agreement amount of $130,836, in substantial form as attached for extended biological monitoring and excavated sand delivery for the Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project; 2) Recommend City Council ratify work completed to date by the San Elijo Lagoon Conservancy and approve work to be performed by the Conservancy pursuant to this Amendment 1 to the Agreement with the City; 3) Adopt Budget Amendment Resolution 2019-36 to transfer $31,369 from the Sand Compatibility Opportunistic Use Program (SCOUP) (WB08C) to the Cardiff State Beach Living Shoreline Project (CSBLSP) (CP16A) for biological monitoring and reporting due to extended project duration increasing the combined project budget not to exceed amount to $2,924,555.
2019-05-22 Item 08L San Elijo Lagoon Conservancy Agreement Amendment
8M.
Facilities Janitorial Services Agreement. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute the Facilities Janitorial Service Agreement for the Civic Center, Library, Public Works and Wastewater Collections facilities between the City of Encinitas and California Office Cleaning for an initial three-year term and authorize the City Manager to extend the Agreement for one three-year renewal option upon satisfactory performance and mutual agreement for a total amount not to exceed $1,028,061.
2019-05-22 Item 08M Janitorial Services Contract
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.

PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10A.
Public hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of the Cardiff School Modernization and Reconstruction project for the property located at 1888 Montgomery Avenue. Contact Person: Associate Planner Maynard ard
Deny the appeal and adopt Resolution No. 2019-35 (Attachment CC-1 of the agenda report) affirming the decision of the Planning Commission to approve the project.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
